nightSafetyAnxiety.title: Women Reporting Feeling Unsafe Walking Alone After Dark (%)

summaryNotes.2004: Initial baseline: Parliaments under 16% female, substantial legal gaps in domestic violence and marital property laws.
summaryNotes.2009: Pre-SDG era (MDG 3): Gradual increase in primary education parity, but economic and physical security lagging.
summaryNotes.2014: Adoption prep for Agenda 2030: Recognition of unpaid care burden and gender-based violence as systemic blockers.
summaryNotes.2019: Rise of global movements (#MeToo, Ni Una Menos): Accelerated reporting and legal reforms in over 40 nations.
summaryNotes.2024: Current Telemetry: Significant legal gains (77.9 index), but night safety and economic equality remain urgent challenges.
